title: Cinatra stateful-service upgrade matrix
description: Machine-readable, versioned source->target upgrade matrix for every stateful service in docker-compose.yml. Single source of truth shared by cinatra-cli (preflight + `db upgrade-major`) and the cinatra works-after harness (upgrade-from arm). See docs/internals/architecture/stateful-service-inventory.md for the human-readable inventory and rationale. Generated/checked by scripts/check-upgrade-matrix.mjs against the live compose file (fail-closed completeness).

schemaVersion.description: SemVer of THIS document's shape (the schema). A consumer built against a different MAJOR must refuse to parse.

revision.description: Monotonic content revision. Bumped on ANY content change. Consumers pin the revision they were built against and fail-closed on skew (see consumptionContract).

baselineRelease.description: The release whose shipped pins define the supported source baseline (epic decision, cinatra#1419).

stateClasses.description: The closed vocabulary of state classifications used by services[].stateClass.

failClosed.description: The default resolution for any (service, from, to) tuple NOT explicitly listed as a supported transition or a case exception.

caseExceptions.description: Pre-baseline / concrete-deployment transitions supported for a NAMED case without widening the general baseline (epic decision; cinatra#1417 is the first consumer).

composeService.description: The exact service key in docker-compose.yml. `null` ONLY for a derived family that owns no compose service of its own (graphiti's state lives in neo4j).

volume.description: The named top-level volume this service persists to. null for stateless-but-schema-migrating (none currently) or derived services.

profile.description: The compose profile gating the service, or `default` if it starts on a bare `docker compose up`.

appManagedSchema.description: true when a bundled app (Plane/Twenty/WordPress/Drupal) runs its OWN schema migrations at boot ON TOP of the engine data dir — the platform drizzle ledger does NOT cover it.

upstreamDictated.description: true when the engine major is chosen by an upstream bundled app (we track, we do not lead).

coupledAppImages.description: App images that own NO volume but run implicit schema migrations against THIS service's data dir at boot (e.g. the Plane app images migrate plane-db). Frozen alongside the engine and pin-drift-checked against compose, even though they carry no state of their own.

image.description: The exact `repo:tag[@sha256:...]` string as it appears (after ${VAR:-default} resolution) in docker-compose.yml. Checked byte-for-byte against compose by scripts/check-upgrade-matrix.mjs.

floatingBefore.description: The floating tag this pin replaced, if any (audit trail for the two frozen tags).

skippedMajor.description: How skipped majors are handled for THIS family: `allowed` (one hop crosses any span — e.g. Postgres logical dump/restore), `sequential-only` (must step through each major — e.g. MariaDB), `linear` (single successor line — e.g. Neo4j CalVer, redis), or `n-a`.
